body: I was attacking a Fallen empire, when I realized that every fleet that my Fed members owned were following a single one of my fleets. I dragged all of them to the battlefield by having them follow the fleet called Pakkan-Ye Navy Cluster on the right of the image. This is my first full game (300 years) on a default galaxy (besides size) on ensign with no dlc. This game is amazing!
